results.rationale: Consistency: Excluding the requested left-phone resizing, the hand grips/finger contours and desk/monitor background details have visibly changed; the right phone and blue sleeves retain their general appearance. Instruction: The left phone is still substantially shorter and narrower than the right phone, with no meaningful enlargement toward a size match. A successful edit would give both phones the same apparent dimensions, so the requested change is absent. Quality: Structure, lighting and surface textures are coherent, but a small beige tab protruding from the left phone’s upper edge is an isolated visual imperfection.

Consistency: The wood floor, plug, cables, charger lettering and general casing remain consistent, but the port interiors/shapes and their voltage labels are visibly altered beyond a change in number. Instruction: The edited charger still has ten USB sockets arranged in two columns of five. The expected result is six sockets; no requested reduction is present. Quality: Lighting, casing and plug are coherent, but numerous socket interiors have warped, rough geometry and the repeated voltage labels are garbled, producing multiple distracting defects.
